domain.value: joint image-video tokenizer (spatial window attention + causal temporal attention transformer; VQVAE for LM generation, KL-finetuned VAE for diffusion) used for language-model and diffusion video generation; trained on general video (Kinetics-600 human-action clips) + ImageNet

quotes.quote: We introduce OmniTokenizer, a joint image-video tokenizer which features the following properties:
Equipped with it, both **language model** and **diffusion model** could achieve competitive visual generation results.

The training of VQVAE includes two stages: image-only training on a fixed resolution, and image-video joint training on multiple resolutions. After this, finetune the VQVAE model w/ KL loss to obtain a VAE model.

architecture.type: transformer autoencoder: patch embedding (first frame p x p, following frames t x p x p), 4 window-attention spatial layers + 4 causal temporal layers, hidden 512; VQ codebook 8192 x dim 8 (VQVAE) or Gaussian latent (VAE)
architecture.representation: encoder latents: 8-dim per token on a (1 + T/4) x H/8 x W/8 grid (VQ indices from an 8192-entry codebook for the VQVAE)

pretraining_data.summary: Progressive training: image-only stage (fixed 256x256) then joint image-video stage; released video checkpoints are each trained on ImageNet + one named video benchmark (K600, UCF-101, MiT or SSv2); paper results default to ImageNet + UCF-101. Version checkpoints: ImageNet + Kinetics-600.

We evaluate the visual tokenization performance of OmniTokenizer on both image and video datasets, including ImageNet [ 9 ] , CelebA-HQ [ 21 ] , FFHQ [ 22 ] , Kinetics [ 23 , 6 ] , UCF-101 [ 44 ] , Moments-in-Time (MiT) [ 29 ] , and Something-Something v2 (SSV2) [ 15 ] .
Unless otherwise stated, the results reported in this paper are jointly trained on ImageNet and UCF-101.
We describe an extension of the DeepMind Kinetics human action dataset from 400 classes, each with at least 400 video clips, to 600 classes, each with at least 600 video clips.
The clips are from YouTube video, last 10s, and have a variable resolution and frame rate;
